idea-plugin.name: django-react-forms
idea-plugin.description:
Navigation for django-react-forms: Cmd/Ctrl+click a component key to open the React component registered under it.
  • Python: component = '...' on a class, and component='...' arguments.
  • Templates: {% react_component "..." %}.
Keys are read from registerComponent(...) and registerWidget(...) calls in the project's JavaScript and TypeScript.
